review_method: All 57 rendered 1280x800 PNGs were visually inspected in seven contact sheets. D40 was additionally inspected at full 1280x800 resolution. Capture sidecars for all 57 rows were machine-checked for no_audio=true, reduced_motion=false, non_color=false and ui_scale_percent=100. The exact artifact interaction manifest was machine-checked for 57/57 INTERACTION_PASS rows.

visual_review_summary.D40_full_frame_dense_layout: PASS — title, controls, map/world panes, requirements region, causal panel, input hint and bottom status are inside the 1280x800 frame.

limitations: This is rendered Linux Xvfb capture review plus presentation-level automated controller interaction, not physical Steam Deck hardware evidence.
A silent-mode sidecar proves the no-audio presentation mode was requested and the UI remained operable; it is not a human auditory-accessibility assessment.
This does not establish E1-E6/E8-E12 human, market or timing outcomes.
T8-44 remains dependent on actual Deck-class reference hardware.
notes: This review supports only the deck_no_audio rows of E7. It does not by itself make E7 PASS.
